link.note: Harvey Book p.354 names 'Frederick and Mary (Young) Croup' as Susan's parents; WikiTree calls her Maria Jung. Her own parents are unproven.

bio: Mary (Maria Jung) Young married Frederick Croup/Grub; Harvey's Shupp genealogy calls Susan Croup Shupp 'daughter of Frederick and Mary (Young) Croup', independently confirming the couple shown in John's tree. She is said to have died in 1841 (tree '-1841'); no record found. Her parents per the tree are John Young Sr. and Anna Maria Doll, a link with no online record.
sources: WikiTree Grub-4 (Johann Andreas Grub; research notes, will, deeds, child table): https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Grub-4
